theme: Neighbourhood book-swap festival: unknown answers, hearsay and unanswered questions

messages.author: u-ruth
messages.text: Book-swap festival planning! Target date Saturday 6 September. Venue still open.

messages.author: u-milo
messages.text: Dana said the parish hall might be free that day, but she wasn't sure.

messages.author: u-sunniva
messages.text: Is the hall wheelchair accessible?

messages.author: u-tobiah
messages.text: How many tables can we fit in there?

messages.author: u-amara
messages.text: I can run the children's corner.

messages.author: u-ruth
messages.text: Has anyone actually confirmed the hall with the booking office?

messages.author: u-milo
messages.text: I heard from someone at the cafe that the library might donate 200 books. Not confirmed.

messages.author: u-tobiah
messages.text: Swap rule proposal: one book in, one book out.

messages.author: u-sunniva
messages.text: Plus a free-pick table at the end of the day?

messages.author: u-ruth
messages.text: Agreed: one-in-one-out, and a free-pick table from 3pm.

messages.author: u-amara
messages.text: Will there be coffee? Someone mentioned the cafe might do a stall.

messages.author: u-milo
messages.text: Posters: I'll design them once we have a venue.

messages.author: u-tobiah
messages.text: Apparently the council needs an event permit for anything over 50 people? Not sure that's true.

messages.author: u-ruth
messages.text: No idea, I'll ask at the town office.

messages.author: u-sunniva
messages.text: Festival hours: 10am to 4pm?

messages.author: u-ruth
messages.text: 10 to 4 works.

messages.author: u-amara
messages.text: Children's corner: sorry, I'm away on the 6th after all, have to drop it.

messages.author: u-tobiah
messages.text: I can take over the children's corner.

messages.author: u-milo
messages.text: Update: Dana now says the hall is booked for a wedding on the 6th. Still secondhand, I haven't spoken to the office.

messages.author: u-sunniva
messages.text: If the hall falls through, the school courtyard is an option, weather permitting.

messages.author: u-ruth
messages.text: Let's keep the courtyard as plan B. Nothing decided yet.

messages.author: u-amara
messages.text: Did anyone hear back about step-free access at the hall?

messages.author: u-tobiah
messages.text: Should we cap donations per person?

messages.author: u-milo
messages.text: Fun fact, last year's festival in Brookhollow had 300 visitors, apparently.

messages.author: u-ruth
messages.text: Recap: 6 September, 10am to 4pm, one-in-one-out with free-pick from 3pm, Tobiah on children's corner. Venue still unconfirmed.

messages.author: u-sunniva
messages.text: On coffee: Milo, didn't you say the cafe was interested?

messages.author: u-milo
messages.text: I only heard it secondhand, nobody from the cafe has told me directly.

state.note: Both messages are secondhand reports from the same source (Dana via Milo); the newer report replaces the older one but neither is a confirmation. The venue remains unconfirmed (s5m25). s5m20/s5m21 courtyard is plan B only, not a decision. s5m19 uses 'Update' in a genuinely correcting way.
Amara withdraws (s5m17), Tobiah takes over (s5m18, handover, not a separate pair).

s5m10 adopts s5m08 and adds s5m09's suggestion; additive adoption, nothing is contradicted, so no pair. Library donation (s5m07), cafe coffee (s5m11, s5m27), permit (s5m13) and Brookhollow visitors (s5m24) are hearsay never confirmed. Accessibility (s5m03, paraphrased in s5m22), table count (s5m04) and donation cap (s5m23) were never answered.

questions.question: Is the parish hall free on 6 September?
questions.goldAnswer: Unconfirmed. The latest secondhand report (Dana via Milo) says it is booked for a wedding that day, and nobody has checked with the booking office.
questions.note: Newer hearsay replaces older hearsay; still not a confirmed fact.

questions.question: Is the library donating 200 books?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Milo heard it from someone at the cafe and said it is not confirmed.

questions.question: Is the hall wheelchair accessible?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Sunniva asked and Amara asked again later, but nobody answered.

questions.question: Do we need a council event permit?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Tobiah was not sure it is true, and Ruth said she would ask the town office but never reported back.
questions.note: Hearsay plus an unfulfilled promise to check.

questions.question: What are the swap rules?
questions.goldAnswer: One book in, one book out, with a free-pick table from 3pm.

questions.question: Is Amara running the children's corner?
questions.goldAnswer: No. She dropped it because she is away on the 6th; Tobiah took it over.
textMustNot: I can run the children's corner

questions.question: Has the festival moved to the school courtyard?
questions.goldAnswer: No. The courtyard is only plan B if the hall falls through; nothing has been decided.

questions.question: Is the cafe running a coffee stall at the festival?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. It was only secondhand talk; nobody from the cafe confirmed it.
questions.note: Delayed follow-up confirms it is still hearsay.

questions.question: Did we agree on a cap on donations per person?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Tobiah asked about a cap, but nobody answered, so nothing was agreed.

deletionProbe.question: Why isn't Amara running the children's corner?
